_comment: Canonical app registry for apps.mountainfutures.ch. Drives both the index.html listing and the Caddy basic_auth gate (via /etc/caddy/gen-apps-auth.sh). 'protected': require the shared password. 'listed': false hides the card from the index but the app is still served + gated.

apps.title: Ops Dashboard
apps.desc: Live status of all operational pipelines. Step-by-step progress, durations, and failure alerts.
apps.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/></svg>

apps.title: Kazakhstan Snow Forecast
apps.desc: 10-day operational snow forecast for Kazakhstan. ERA5 + IFS forcing, FSM snow physics, MODIS/station data assimilation.
apps.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 21l4-10 4 10"/><path d="M2 21l6-16 4 8"/><path d="M14 13l4-8 4 16"/></svg>

apps.title: Central Asian Snow Database
apps.desc: Interactive explorer for snow station data across Central Asia. Time series, maps, and station metadata.
apps.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="22"/><path d="M20 6l-8 4-8-4"/><path d="M20 18l-8-4-8 4"/><line x1="2" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"/></svg>

apps.title: Drone Archive Map
apps.desc: Leaflet map of all CROMO-ADAPT drone survey missions in Kyrgyzstan. Flight footprints, snow depth probes, and SWE pit data.
apps.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 22s-8-4.5-8-11.8A8 8 0 0 1 12 2a8 8 0 0 1 8 8.2c0 7.3-8 11.8-8 11.8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg>

apps.title: benchmarkSnow
apps.desc: Compare snow model implementations (FSM, fsm-rs, SNOWPACK, snowpack-rs) across datasets. Metrics, performance, and time series.
apps.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 3v18h18"/><path d="M7 17l4-8 4 4 5-9"/></svg>

apps.title: Tajikistan Glacier Stations
apps.desc: Downscaled ERA5 forcing (2000-2025) for 5 glaciers and 6 ground stations. QM bias correction, obs overlay.
apps.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 21l4-10 4 10"/><path d="M2 21l6-16 4 8"/><path d="M14 13l4-8 4 16"/></svg>

apps.title: 21st Century Snow Scenarios
apps.desc: CMIP6 snow climate scenarios for Central Asia. Near-future (2021-2040) and far-future (2081-2100) projections of SWE, snow depth, runoff, and more across major river basins.
apps.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 2v20"/><path d="M2 12h20"/><path d="M5 5l14 14"/><path d="M19 5L5 19"/></svg>

apps.title: AvaFrame Hazard Tool
apps.desc: Avalanche hazard simulation pipeline. Copernicus DEM, ERA5 snow climatology, com1DFA dense flow simulation, interactive hazard dashboards.
apps.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 21l4-10 4 10"/><path d="M2 21l6-16 4 8"/><path d="M14 13l4-8 4 16"/></svg>
